newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle $112/dressed, light - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle $112/dressed, light - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers rather quiet following the large sales volume on Tuesday, USDA said. Live basis sales not established. Dressed basis sales both steers and heifers steady with a weaker undertone. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights )
Slaughter Steers - Load Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lbs 68.00 live basis; dressed basis 1200-1250 lbs mostly 111.00, few "yearlings" to 112.00, some "calf feds" 110.00. ( weighted average 110.95 )
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs - live basis - no sales; dressed basis mostly 111.00, few "yearlings' to 112.00, some "calf feds" to 110.00. ( weighted average 110.99 )
For week - 73,500 Sm Pd Lst Wk - 101,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 89,600
